thread:
Alex K: heads-up — MapleHealth POC demo tomorrow at 11am PT. Their web client intermittently gets partial stream chunks and JSON.parse fails with `Unexpected end of JSON input`. Demo blocked unless we have a quick mitigation. cc @Samira P @Liam T

Samira P: ugh. do we have the session id / request id from their failing run? need logs + whether they're using EventSource or raw fetch streaming.

Alex K: session=mh-poc-20260321-3, client=EventSource in React (native EventSource polyfill). I saw `499 Client Closed Request` in our access logs and some `upstream prematurely closed connection` in runtime logs.

DeployBot: New log bundle for session mh-poc-20260321-3 uploaded: https://s3.redwood/logs/mh-poc-20260321-3.tar.gz :file_cabinet:

Liam T: likely causes: 1) client expecting a full JSON object per message but backend is emitting chunked JSON (partial object across chunks), 2) an intermediate proxy or rate-limit idle timeout cutting connection, or 3) HTTP buffering altering SSE framing. quick check: can you paste the raw first 6KB of the response body?

Alex K: pasted snippet from logs: ```HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Content-Type: text/event-stream

data: {"id":1,"text":"Hello, this is a v

data: {\"id\":1,"text":" world"}

``` Frontend's Error: `SyntaxError: JSON.parse: unexpected end of data at line 1 column 1 of the JSON data`

Maria S: that raw looks like our runtime is splitting a single JSON across multiple SSE data frames (and the polyfill concatenates differently). With SSE each `data:` line is a fragment — the client needs to join multiple `data:` lines into one event. But some libs treat each `data:` as an independent JSON payload. Two options: ensure backend emits one `data:` with complete JSON per event, or change client to accumulate `data` lines until the event delimiter.

Liam T: also confirm no proxy is re-chunking. For NGINX fronting, ensure: `proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_set_header Connection ""; proxy_buffering off;` and `chunked_transfer_encoding on;`. Proxies sometimes buffer until a newline and then split. Also add `Cache-Control: no-transform` to prevent intermediaries from modifying.

Samira P: good call. Alex — can you ask Maple to try a quick local repro using curl to stream from our endpoint and dump raw bytes? Example: ```curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?sid=mh-poc-20260321-3" | sed -n '1,120p' > raw.txt``` If they get the same partial-split formatting, problem is server/proxy side.

Alex K: asked them to run, they sent back raw.txt. It shows `data:` lines split in the middle of utf8 multibyte sequence sometimes, and their polyfill chokes on that. They also reported intermittent 502/499 spikes when they do several parallel streams.

Liam T: multibyte char split implies chunk boundary is cutting bytes mid-rune — that can happen with naive chunking on a bytes-level. Our runtime should ensure chunks are cut on valid UTF-8 boundaries for SSE text, or better: buffer until full `\n\n` event delimiter before flushing a `data:` line. I'll escalate to eng-runtime.

Maria S: meanwhile, short-term workaround for demo: have client join multiple `data:` lines per event. Example (EventSource handler): ```let buffer = ''; source.onmessage = (e) => { buffer += e.data; try { const obj = JSON.parse(buffer); /* handle obj */ buffer = ''; } catch (err) { /* wait for more chunks */ } };``` Not ideal but should get the demo working.

Samira P: agree. Also disable any rate limiting/connection idle cut on the demo environment for MapleHealth (they're on a short trial). I'll add a temporary exception to their account so the runtime won't cut streams at 30s idle.

Alex K: thanks. One more ask from Maple — will this be a product-level bug (affects Dedicated/Private) or only polyfill combos? They want timeline and whether we can patch before next week.

Liam T: this is a runtime bug when using chunked flush policy + SSE text: it can produce byte-split chunks. We'll treat as high priority for Dedicated and Hosted. ETA for a patch: initial mitigation (avoid splitting utf8 or ensure event delimiter) — 48–72 hrs if we can push a small change to the flushing logic. I'll create an internal ticket and assign. :white_check_mark:

DeployBot: Created ticket RED-INF-4721: "sse: avoid utf8-split on chunk flush" assigned to eng-runtime. Priority: P1.

Samira P: I'll coordinate with Maple for a targeted deploy window if we need to change their Dedicated config. For Hosted, we can roll a patch behind a feature flag and enable for their org.

Alex K: for the demo I'll ask them to apply the client-side buffer trick and disable their polyfill to use native EventSource where possible. Also will share the `raw.txt` and the DeployBot ticket. :thumbsup:

Maria S: follow-up note for the support playbook: add checklist for streaming POCs: 1) verify `Accept: text/event-stream`, 2) check for `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` + UTF-8 boundary handling, 3) check proxies (NGINX) buffering settings, 4) rate-limit & idle timeouts, 5) provide client-side fallback code snippet. I'll draft and attach to RED-INF-4721.

Liam T: adding log grep we used: ```grep -n "mh-poc-20260321-3" /var/log/runtime/* | sed -n '1,120p'``` If anyone needs the exact stack traces I'll paste them into the ticket.

Alex K: great — thanks everyone. I’ll run the demo with client fallback and update the thread after 11:30 PT. :eyes:

Samira P: ping me if the demo still fails, we'll spin up eng on-call.

Liam T: will follow up in RED-INF-4721 with a small test harness so we can reproduce the utf8-split locally.

Alex K: demo passed — client fallback worked, no crashes. Maple is happy for now but wants the runtime fix. Closing loop here, moving details into the ticket. :party_popper:
